The points where the multiple strands attach to the central pendant cluster are somewhat indistinct. It is unclear exactly how the strands connect to the stone cluster, suggesting a slight fusion or lack of clear mechanical attachment points.

The background pattern has a slightly painterly or smudged quality in areas, which could be an artifact of generation or just low-resolution compression, but lacks the crispness of a real macro photograph.

To verify the physical connectivity of the strands to the clasp and the pendant, ensuring no floating elements or impossible fusions.
To critically assess the realism of the reflections on the metal and the sharpness of the gemstone facets, which are common failure points in AI-generated jewelry.
